recipe.visualDefinition: A nostalgic, soft-focus portrait of three women in a vintage setting, featuring a heavy aged-paper border, a central hand-drawn scribble graphic, and a mix of raw gestural lettering and clean sans-serif typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Warm sepia tones contrasting with cool blue-grey garments
Sharp hand-drawn scribbles overlaid on soft-focus photography
Heavy textured border framing the central intimate group composition
Vertical hierarchy between expressive top text and structured bottom text
coreInvariants: Aged paper texture border with visible creases
Circular chaotic scribble graphic as a visual anchor
Soft, warm lighting with low contrast and muted saturation

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three subjects seated in the center-right, occupying approximately 60% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: A black circular scribble graphic located on the left-center, overlapping the subjects.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the expressive white lettering on the left, through the subjects' faces, down to the structured text at the bottom edge.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy beige textured border provides significant breathing room around the central image.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm beige and sepia tones in the border and skin tones.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks in the scribble graphic and shadows.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted teal/blue in the clothing and carousel background.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with a high-key, hazy value range in the highlights.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to earth tones and desaturated pastels

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Hand-drawn gestural script and geometric sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Primary text: Raw, uneven strokes with varying thickness, mimicking chalk or paint marker.
Secondary text: Monolinear, wide-tracked geometric sans-serif with thin strokes.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'S' in the primary text has an elongated, sharp tail.
The 'A' and 'Y' feature exaggerated, expressive terminals.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between raw, chaotic gestural marks and rigid, spaced-out geometric order.

preserve: Wide tracking on the bottom text
Hand-drawn feel of the main title

candidateDirections.reason: To match the raw, expressive energy of the main title.
For the clean, wide-tracked secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a soft-focus, warm-toned photograph of three women sitting together in a vintage carousel setting. Apply a heavy, aged beige paper border with creases and a subtle vignette. Add a black, chaotic circular scribble graphic on the left side overlapping the subjects.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the main title in a white, hand-drawn gestural script over the scribble. Add the secondary title at the very bottom in a thin, white, widely-spaced geometric sans-serif.

verificationChecks: Is the border sufficiently textured and aged?
Does the scribble graphic feel organic and chaotic?
Is the bottom text tracking extremely wide?
Is the overall image focus soft and nostalgic?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the sepia/warm color grade
Tracking distance of the bottom text
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subjects

mustAchieve: Balanced contrast between the scribble and the soft photo

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the white text is legible against the background
Check that the scribble does not obscure the faces entirely
Verify the border texture looks like physical paper
Confirm the wide tracking on the bottom text is maintained
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a soft-focus nostalgic portrait with a heavy aged-paper frame, a central chaotic line-art anchor, and a typographic contrast of raw gesture versus geometric order.
